HELD-OUT EVALUATION

How close were the predictions?

ModelMAERMSER²Within 10%

MAE is the average absolute error in rupees. RMSE gives larger errors more weight. “Within 10%” counts predictions within ten percent of the observed fare.

HISTORICAL SNAPSHOT

Indian domestic fare observations

300,153 economy and business listings from EaseMyTrip cover six airlines and six Indian metros during February–March 2022. Prices are one-way fares in Indian rupees.

AirportCityObserved destinationsAirlines in dataset

Airline names and service patterns reflect the collection period. The workspace offers combinations observed in the training data. Individual inputs may still be sparse.
